item.title: Version 0.1.2
item.description:
## What's New in Version 0.1.2
- **✨ New Features** - **Added dark mode support** for better nighttime coding. - **Introduced auto-save functionality** to prevent data loss. - **New customizable toolbar** with quick-access buttons. - **Integrated basic Markdown preview** for notes and documentation.
- **🐛 Bug Fixes** - **Fixed app crash** when opening multiple projects simultaneously. - **Resolved layout issues** in the settings panel. - **Corrected file export errors** for certain special characters. - **Improved stability** when importing large project files.
